blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: element — HTML start/end tags and content.
form — Collects and submits user data.
GET — HTTP method placing data in request URL.

blocks.title: Understand
blocks.text: HTML uses nested elements to give structure and semantics: head contains metadata and body contains visible content.

blocks.title: Trace
blocks.text: Forms collect and submit inputs. The label's for value matches input's id; the input's name is the key submitted to the server.

blocks.title: Evaluate
blocks.text: With method GET, query parameters appear in the URL; don't use GET for confidential credentials. Client-side required validation improves usability but is not a substitute for server validation.

blocks.title: Worked example · Predict first
blocks.text: The action sets the destination path '/find' and GET encodes form fields into URL query parameters.

blocks.title: Worked example · Show method
blocks.text: The input name 'q' becomes the query key and 'binary' the value.
